policy.coordinates: Unicode codepoints, half-open; source is decoded revision wikitext, not XML bytes
policy.unicode: identity; no NFC/NFKC or simplified/traditional conversion
policy.whitespace: CRLF/CR -> LF; tab/NBSP -> space; other whitespace preserved
policy.entities: semicolon-terminated HTML entities decoded; complete source entity span retained even for multiple codepoints
policy.links: main-title links retain explicit label or literal title; all colon targets and empty pipe tricks excluded
policy.external_links: explicit labels only; URLs without labels excluded
policy.templates_tables_comments: excluded completely with source spans and synthetic double-newline boundaries
policy.tags: b/i/em/strong/sup/sub/nowiki without attributes retained; others excluded
policy.unsupported_plain_markup: reject article when markup delimiters, variant conversion or magic words remain in plain nodes
policy.discontinuities: synthetic separators require separate index segments; no cross-boundary phrase/gap matching
policy.publication: NOT_PUBLISHED; restricted development subset, not complete article text

dependency.platform: CPython 3.12 Windows AMD64 isolated S0 experiment
dependency.scope: source AST parser; no template expansion or MediaWiki render
